calls.statement:
SELECT
 count(*) AS rows_all,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS current_rows,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS current_distinct,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE is_current AND home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)) AS tampere_current,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current AND home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)) AS tampere_current_rows,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)) AS tampere_any_version,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE is_current AND home_store_id = 900) AS online_current,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE is_current AND home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136) AND marketing_consent) AS tampere_consent,
 min(join_date), max(join_date), min(valid_from), max(valid_from),
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current AND valid_to <> DATE '9999-12-31') AS bad_current_flag,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_current AND valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS bad_noncurrent_flag
FROM dim_member

calls.statement:
SELECT home_store_id, count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS cur, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT store_name, ',') FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_id = m.home_store_id) AS nm
FROM dim_member m GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)),
act AS (SELECT member_key, max(sale_date) AS last_sale, min(sale_date) AS first_sale, count(*) AS n FROM fact_sales_line WHERE member_key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1),
actm AS (SELECT m.member_id, max(a.last_sale) AS last_sale, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.n>0) AS vers_with_sales FROM dim_member m JOIN act a USING(member_key) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t) AS tampere_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t JOIN actm USING(member_id)) AS with_any_purchase,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t JOIN actm USING(member_id) WHERE last_sale >= DATE '2025-10-08') AS bought_last_12m,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE join_date > valid_from) AS join_after_valid,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates) AS stg_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member d WHERE d.member_key = s.member_key)) AS stg_not_in_dim,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=t.home_store_id AND s.is_current WHERE s.close_date IS NOT NULL) AS closed_home,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale
